published.source: the DPS report's main run of this request after hotfix push 114097 (Unbridled Wrath on melee abilities except Whirlwind, one Reckless Swings charge a Cleave) and an avoided Execute keeping its extra Rage (wowsimcli, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s)

verify.note: the report main run of this request (2026-11-17), 180 ± 20 s, 20,000 iterations, seed 1

summary: Two-hand Arms with Mortal Strike, Slam and Rend, plus Overpower after dodges and Bloodthrill procs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Battle Stance, then Charge (15 Rage)
Sunder Armor as the first GCD. Every warrior does this, and the tanks keep it up after
With 25s left, if Recklessness is ready and Rage is under 25, swap to Berserker Stance. Swap back after Recklessness
Recklessness in the last 25s. Racials on cooldown, but Elune's Light never during Recklessness or the 15s before it
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, the second in the last 15s. Bloodrage under 20 Rage
Slam at 20+ Rage outside execute, ahead of Mortal Strike (10s cooldown with Improved Slam)
Overpower at 5+ Rage after a dodge or Bloodthrill
Keep Rend up outside execute. Then Execute
Mortal Strike, Overpower, Rend, Execute and Hamstring wait out the 0.1s after a main hand swing, so a Windfury Totem proc from the swing (100 ms cooldown) doesn't take their roll
Reckless Swings under 20 Rage, only when no strike is ready, since it takes a 1s GCD. The next 4 swings give 5 more Rage each
Heroic Strike at 90+ Rage and Hamstring filler at 10+, both outside execute
caveats: Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 10.9 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 8.4 DPS vs Humanoids.
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing, because the raid already has Battle Shout
Arms in Berserker Stance with Whirlwind is 10% behind.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec arms -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_arms -talents 30303213032215201-05050005012-2 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Not the class default: the warrior UI has one spec page and its default Level 60 build is two-hand Fury (Fury Dual Wield until 2026-11-03); this is the only Arms preset. Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Orc since the 2026-11-03 race re-pick (the November 2 notes; Undead from 2026-10-27). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull, and the preset's own pull Sunder is the raid's other one. 2026-11-15 (Windfury Totem rolls on every main-hand hit, standards 17): the knob search over 120, 180 and 300 s moved nothing; the strikes wait out the 0.1 s after a main hand swing (wfGate=1), ++0.8 / +0.8 / +0.4 and +0.7 / +2.0 / +1.9 at 120 / 180 / 300 s (seeds 1 / 1000003, 20,000 iterations). Waiting out the 0.1 s before the next swing too (wfGate=2) loses on Arms.
